name: tool-dependency-graph-generator
notes: The catalog path must be the LAST CLI argument (matches the provided skeleton's contract: `process.argv[process.argv.length - 1]`). Always writes dependency_graph.json to the current working directory. If OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL are set in the environment, an additional LLM-assisted pass automatically proposes producer edges for required parameters the deterministic heuristics couldn't resolve; this is purely additive and any failure is caught so the heuristic graph is always still written.
